title: Syrian Tagine with Uni Velvety Sauce
description: A rich and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring tender uni and a velvety sauce, all slow-cooked in a traditional tagine.
instructions: Season the uni with salt and pepper.
In a traditional clay tagine or Dutch oven, melt the vegan butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the uni and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the velvety sauce mix and lemon juice.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
